verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents a create-broadcast endpoint that can draft or schedule a send to all subscribers or to a segment or tag subset. It also documents update, get (including the `send_at` schedule) and delete endpoints for draft or scheduled broadcasts, and API-key auth for automating your own account. Together these cover creating and scheduling broadcasts through the API alone. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an end-to-end API-only scheduled send works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard
